What gets in the way today

Manual history extraction

Name changes, capital increases and board changes are spread across fragmented filings.

Hidden conflicts of interest

Shared directorships between opposing parties or deal partners are hard to spot.

Turnaround pressure

Clients want faster due diligence without any loss of accuracy.

How IncoInfo fits your workflow

Data from MCA / RoC filings Secure payments Encrypted in transit

IncoInfo compiles information from public and official sources, including filings with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs / Registrar of Companies, GST registries and registered charge records. Reports are provided for reference and due diligence. They reflect each company’s filings up to its latest submission on record and are not investment, credit or legal advice. Verify material facts independently before acting on them.
